thread:
Tess: q6b-int8 landed on staging. perf looks fine but we're seeing more hallucinations on short prompts from the longtail bank. want curation ops to run a quick sampling + dedupe before canary. @Pranav @Alana :eyes:
Pranav: got it. which shard to sample from? longtail_v2 or the new multi-intent shard?
Tess: longtail_v2 for the canary. sampling plan: stratify by len_bucket + token_freq, target ~5k post-dedupe. run fingerprint dedupe first. also need a microgolden of ~400 focused on listicle/hallucination cases.
Alana: I can start dedupe now. ETA ~20m for fingerprint pass, then ~30m to package for labeling. any golden overlap rules?
Ryan: keep regression_core_v3 immutable and exclude it from sampling. snapshot it and run overlap check.
Tess: correct — exclude regression_core_v3 entirely. microgolden should be drawn after dedupe and annotated separately, tag metadata model=q6b-int8 + experiment=quant-reg0.
Pranav: SQL sprint for sampling (placeholder):
```
SELECT id, prompt, len, fingerprint FROM sample_bank
WHERE shard='longtail_v2' AND label IS NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN len < 50 THEN 1 WHEN len < 200 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, RANDOM()
LIMIT 8000;
```
(we'll filter down after dedupe to ~5k)
Alana: starting dedupe job now (job jb-4823). will run fingerprint pass then near-dup cluster.
curation-bot: job jb-4823 queued -> running. started fingerprinting 1747512370. ETA 18m.
Tess: for the quant experiment, plan a side-by-side eval against q6b-fp16. metrics: hallucination_rate, RougeL, and a factuality check (simple QA overlap). rollback thresholds: hallucination_rate increase > 2.5% absolute OR regression on regression_core_v3 > 1% absolute.
Pranav: will sample 600 then prune to 400 for microgolden after labeler dedupe. will tag outputs with metadata: model=q6b-int8, experiment=quant-reg0, seedset=postdedupe_174751.
Alana: labelers are stretched — recommend marking LabelFlow LF-778 priority high. I'll push 500 items to LF-778 and let labelers reduce to 400 by dropping near-duplicates.
Ryan: also run automated eval script for quick sanity before labels:
```
./eval/run_cmp.sh q6b-fp16 q6b-int8 --prompts /shared/curation/shortlist.json --metrics halluc,rouge,factscore
```
Pranav: uploaded shortlist to /shared/curation/q6b_int8_microgolden.json and kicked off pre-label eval.
Alana: dedupe finished 1747512605. output: 5142 samples post-dedupe, 620 near-duplicates flagged, 500 pushed to LabelFlow LF-778.
Pranav: started label task (LF-778). ETA ~6h for first pass. tagging annotators with guidance: focus on hallucinations and factual correctness, mark contextual duplicates.
QA-bot: Canary plan created: canary-id c-8921, traffic=5%, auto-rollback enabled, alerting -> @eng-oncall.
Tess: perfect. after labels come back we'll run canary with the thresholds above. if regression spikes early we hold. :thumbsup:
Ryan: quick note — log token-level latency too, quant sometimes affects output timing under our batching kernel. add latency per-token to the canary dashboard.
Tess: good call. thanks all, keep updates in this thread and @me if labels slip.
